title: Silence U Part 2: What Has Yale Become? | We the Internet Documentary
summary: A short documentary on the 2015 Yale Halloween costume controversy and the confrontation with Nicholas Christakis. Filmmaker Rob Montz investigates campus free speech and the state of the university afterward.
why: Cited in debates about campus culture, free speech and workplace diversity controversies as a window into a particular mindset.

quote.text: There's a good short video here that explores what's been happening at Yale
